data.long_meaning: The name Jitu is derived from the Sanskrit word 'jit', which means 'victory' or 'conqueror'. In Hindu mythology, Jitu is a name given to gods and heroes who have achieved victory over their enemies or challenges. It is a name that embodies strength, courage, and triumph. The name Jitu carries the meaning “Victorious, Triumphant” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Jitu usually hope their child will grow to embody victorious, triumphant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
